name: Mountainheart
place: walks the crater lake shore below Rim Shrine; a red light beats in its chest like a heart
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). A golem with a lump of the mountain's own fire for a heart. Its heartbeat pulses out round it on a steady rhythm (step back on the beat), it slams a cone, and cracks the ground in magma veins that stay hot. At half health its heart flares: fire rides every player and the beat gets faster.

party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: A boulder on the shore has a heartbeat.
Mountainheart stands. The red light in its chest beats faster.
say.death: Mountainheart's heart gives one last beat and goes dark.
say.reset: Mountainheart sits back down on the shore. The beat slows.

heartbeat.name: Heartbeat
heartbeat.say: Thump... thump... — step back on the beat!

vein.name: Magma Vein
vein.say: The ground splits toward {target} and fills with magma!

flare.name: Heart Flare
flare.say: Its heart flares — fire on everyone! Spread out!

phases.name: Racing Heart
phases.say: Mountainheart's heart races and flares white!
